subtitle: A cozy cosmic rescue puzzle
promotionalText: Turn stardust into a home. Slide, match and rescue your tiny cosmic crew across 1,000 missions.
description:
Build a home among the stars, one clever match at a time.

Slide neighboring terrain to make matches, grow habitats, build rescue shuttles and bring stranded travelers home. Every little guest has a destination, and every mission is a fresh cosmic puzzle.

Explore 1,000 missions across 20 constellations. Boards change size and shape as new rescue challenges arrive gradually: supply crates, ice, rovers, moonwhales, playful pirate drones, gardens, gravity switches and more.

Take your time planning each move. Retry freely, ask for a hint, and celebrate each rescue. Cute characters, bright space art and playful animations make your growing station feel like home.

Play offline with progress saved on your device. No account, advertisements, subscriptions or in-app purchases are required.
betaDescription: Sliding Stars is a cozy space rescue puzzle. Slide adjacent terrain into matches, grow habitats, create rescue shuttles and guide stranded travelers home. Includes a 1,000-mission campaign, changing board shapes and gradually introduced rescue mechanics. Progress stays on your device; the game works offline and requires no login or purchases.
whatsNew: Complete campaign release candidate: 1,000 verified missions, new late-campaign rescue puzzles, clearer shuttle rules, live finger dragging, automatic mission advancement, original space graphics and offline play. Please test touch controls, save/resume and the gradually introduced mechanics.
reviewNotes: This is an offline single-player puzzle game. No account or demo login is required. Launch directly into mission 1. Drag an adjacent terrain tile to create a match; the field guide explains the terrain progression and rescue rules. Finished missions celebrate and automatically advance. Settings include reduced motion and sound controls. The campaign has 1,000 missions; no paid items, ads, subscriptions, external user content or tracking. Game progress and settings are stored only on the device. App Store Connect screenshots show actual gameplay.
